Found **one merge-blocking issue** in `dedupe-imports` against `main` (head `62644c3`):

**[P1] Deduplication uses object identity, not contact ID — `src/dedupe.js:2`**
`new Set(contacts)` only removes repeated references to the same object. Overlapping imports contain separate objects with equal IDs, so duplicates survive through `mergeImports`, violating the documented first-seen-per-ID behavior.

Reproduced with:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
```
Actual: both contacts. Expected: only the first.

**Suggested fix:** track seen IDs while retaining the first contact. Add regression tests for distinct objects sharing an ID, both directly in `dedupe` and across lists in `mergeImports`.

All 4 existing tests pass, but they miss that case. No files changed.
